audit_kind: Read-only content integrity, raw samples and ATT time-axis comparison
interpretation: NPZ raw_counts are unchanged digital numbers after merging original segments; missing-data sentinel -1 is retained, not waveform amplitude. Mask -1 as NaN for plotting.
NPZ t is ATT affine-corrected time relative to NASA Earth-received source time, not the original MiniSEED nominal time. Counts have not been time-resampled.
For strict original archival waveform use raw MiniSEED nominal time; for aligned raw/processed comparison use NPZ ATT time for both and explicitly label this correction.
Do not present processed velocity as absolute calibrated amplitude until gain history has been reconstructed.

The stored velocity already includes response removal and 10-second segment-edge exclusion. The older 0.3-0.9 Hz plot adds another edge exclusion; raw gaps and processing exclusions must be separately marked.
